items.prompt: Node v has distance 6, count 3. Another predecessor contributes 4 routes with the same total distance 6. What happens?

options.text: Keep count 3 because the distance did not improve.
options.why: Equal-distance link sequences must still contribute to the count.
The predecessor route count is not a latency.

options.text: Reset count to 4 and discard the earlier 3.
options.why: That loses already established shortest routes of the same distance.

options.text: Keep distance 6 and set count 7 modulo 1000000007.
options.why: Equal-distance updates add the predecessor multiplicity rather than resetting it.

items.explanation: Equal-distance updates add the predecessor multiplicity rather than resetting it.
